q: What is the carbon footprint of vegetables from an indoor vertical farm?
title: Vertical farm footprint per kg
short: Mostly electricity for LED lighting, air conditioning and pumps. On India's grid at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, kWh per kg decides the result, so measure it. Rooftop solar or contracted renewable power can cut market-based Scope 2. Add packaging and delivery.
audience: Indoor farm operators and food retailers

ul: Total kWh per month, ideally split into lighting, cooling and pumps.
Kg of saleable produce per month.

p: Field-grown produce trucked long distances can still be lower. Compare per kg delivered, with stated assumptions.

example.title: Worked example (illustrative)
lines: Electricity: 10 kWh per kg of lettuce (illustrative)
10 x 0.710 = 7.1 kg CO2 per kg from electricity alone
example.note: Illustrative figure only. Use your own metered kWh and output.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel invoices and electricity bills and applies IPCC 2006 factors and the CEA grid factor (0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25), so you can compare Scope 1 and 2 before and after a change from the documents themselves.
